data_range_of — IMGMETRICS report op

• Data kinds: image2d → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.data_range_of(*arrays, data_range=None) (to call the implementation directly, import imgmetrics; imgmetrics.data_range_of(*arrays, data_range=None); from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("data_range_of"))

Usage

Decide the span the pixel values may take. It does not guess.

For integer dtypes it is uniquely determined by the dtype. Float is treated as 1.0 only when it lies within [0, 1] and otherwise an explicit data_range is required.

Measuring PSNR of a [0, 1] float as if it were 255 is off by 48.13 dB, yet no exception is raised -- only a plausible-looking number comes out, so it is stopped here.

Parameters

*arrays : ndarray

Arrays that should share the same pixel-value convention (usually 2 images).

data_range : float, optional

The range when given explicitly. ValueError unless it is a positive finite value.

Returns

float
